cutoff_rule: prediction_cutoff_utc = scheduled_tip_utc - 1 hour (EXACT tip); start of the US/Eastern game date (00:00 ET) when the tip is not exact. A source game may contribute only when its historical_knowable_at (canonical PIT rule HR-1: tip + 4 h, or 06:00 ET next day for inexact tips) <= prediction_cutoff_utc. Since the target game is knowable only at tip + 4 h it can never contribute to its own features. CBBD wallclock is UNTRUSTED_MIXED and is never read.
